subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI keep blocking remote HTTP(S) avatar rendering and only improve docs/local diagnostics, or should OpenClaw add a server-mediated remote-avatar display path?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses the current browser image-policy and authenticated local file-serving boundary, so automation should not choose the privacy/security contract on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Keep CSP And Fix Diagnostics
options.body: Preserve the remote-image block, clarify CLI/Control UI docs, and improve metadata-driven UI messages for missing or oversized local avatars.

options.title: Add Server-Mediated Remote Avatars
options.body: Proxy or fetch remote avatars through a bounded Gateway path with explicit size, MIME, caching, and privacy controls before rendering them as data/blob URLs.

options.title: Allow Direct Remote Rendering
options.body: Relax the current image policy or redirect behavior so remote URLs render directly, accepting the operator-browser privacy and CSP tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep CSP And Fix Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Preserve the remote-image block, clarify CLI/Control UI docs, and improve metadata-driven UI messages for missing or oversized local avatars.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and security-hardening history for avatar serving concentrates in commits authored by this owner path.
